$comment: Authoritative decision-case table for scripts/port-tick/pacing.mjs's nextDelay. Per plugins/port/skills/pipeline/SKILL.md → 'Pacing': floor with no backoff whenever something will move without a human; otherwise advance one rung per consecutive no-change tick; reset to the floor unconditionally on any observed change.

cases.name: something will move — floor, cadence reset
no-change tick from the floor — advances one rung
capped at the top rung, never advances past it
an observed change resets to the floor even on an otherwise no-change tick
